decisions.reason: After several years a height-adjustable executive desk system that extends the core office offer and comes in multiple models likely meets aspiration levels well enough that management would retain it.
The chair family sits very close to the firm's established premium furnishing range, and its survival to 2022 suggests results are not far enough below aspiration to trigger withdrawal.

The floor cushions remain more peripheral and niche than the firm's main lines, so they face a higher withdrawal risk, but the firm's design and material capabilities still make continued retention more likely than exit.

A high standing table fits the firm's workplace and conference solutions closely, and in a stable industry with some organisational slack management would usually keep such an adjacent product unless performance clearly disappointed.

Although more distant from the legacy offer, the rug collection was framed as a flagship strategic direction and therefore is likely to receive continued support unless its results fall clearly below aspiration.
